source.title: Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007 — I. Prélude

bars.description: Prelude bars 1–42 once in written order, with no pickup or repeat. Only the first score in the complete-suite archive is selected; the six dance movements and viola transposition are not used.

endpoints.basis: Initial source-pitch search windows from the cached 130.312-second recording and its analysis: opening G2 and final G2–B3–G4 chord. Inspect fresh pitch-energy evidence before publication.

provenance: The original bwv1007.ly compiles the Prelude first, followed by the six dance scores. Its unsuffixed bwv1007.mid contains 656 attacks over 168 quarter units, beginning G2–D3–B3 and ending with the bar-42 G2–B3–G4 chord; the separately named viola files are excluded.
Extraction and engraving select the unchanged prelude variable and retain the original wrapper’s transpose c c, exactly once. This is the source’s cello octave, not a recording-derived transposition.

One cello staff contains temporary notational subdivisions in bars 33–36; they are not advertised as continuous contrapuntal voices. The bar-22 fermata D4 eighth tied to a sixteenth remains one written event. Written holds and slurs do not establish performed bow changes or release times.
